function.name: topsolid_get_state
function.description: Return the current TopSolid state: edited document, document type, associated project. Requires a running TopSolid session.

function.name: topsolid_run_recipe
function.description: Executes one of the 219 pre-built TopSolid recipes. Do NOT write code - pick a recipe name. Categories: ASSEMBLIES, ATTRIBUTES, AUDIT, BATCH, BOM, DOCUMENT, DRAFTING, EXPORT, FAMILIES, GEOMETRY, MATERIALS, MEASUREMENTS, PARAMETERS, PDM PROPERTIES, PROFILES 7.21, PROJECTS, SKETCH, UNFOLDING, USER PROPERTIES. Use topsolid_list_recipes to find the exact name of a recipe.

recipe.description: Exact recipe name (e.g. 'read_designation'). Call topsolid_list_recipes to search the catalogue by category or keyword.

value.description: Value for parameterized recipes (e.g. name, path, name:value)

function.name: topsolid_list_recipes
function.description: Lists the built-in TopSolid recipes (name, mode, description), filtered by category and/or keyword. Use it to find the exact recipe name to pass to topsolid_run_recipe. Categories: ASSEMBLIES, ATTRIBUTES, AUDIT, BATCH, BOM, DOCUMENT, DRAFTING, EXPORT, FAMILIES, GEOMETRY, MATERIALS, MEASUREMENTS, PARAMETERS, PDM PROPERTIES, PROFILES 7.21, PROJECTS, SKETCH, UNFOLDING, USER PROPERTIES. No TopSolid connection required.

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. 'EXPORT', 'DRAFTING'). Omit to search every category.

search.description: Optional keyword, matched against the recipe name and description.

max_results.description: Maximum number of recipes returned. Default 30, maximum 100.

function.name: topsolid_search_help
function.description: Full-text search the TopSolid online help (5809 pages, EN+FR). Returns ranked excerpts with title, domain and file path. Use this to answer 'how does feature X work' questions, find menu locations, or learn TopSolid workflow before writing automation code.

query.description: FTS5 query. Supports AND/OR/NOT, phrases "...", prefix foo*, column filters (title:sketch). Unicode-aware, diacritics folded.

lang.description: Restrict to 'EN' or 'FR'. Omit for both.

domain.description: Restrict to one domain: Cad, Cae, Cam, Erp, Kernel, Pdm, WorkManager.
